list.name: var_company
list.label: Company Filter
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT server_meta->'asn'->>'org' FROM test_runs WHERE server_meta->'asn'->>'org' IS NOT NULL

list.name: var_asn
list.label: ASN Filter
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT 'AS' || (server_meta->'asn'->>'asn') FROM test_runs WHERE server_meta->'asn'->>'asn' IS NOT NULL

list.name: var_country
list.label: Country Filter
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' FROM test_runs WHERE server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' IS NOT NULL

list.name: var_client_network
list.label: Client Network
list.query: Mobile : Mobile, Whitelist : Whitelist, Regular : Regular

options.content: **Jump to:** [01 Overview](/d/censprobe-01) · [02 Blocking Matrix](/d/censprobe-02) · [03 Telegram](/d/censprobe-03) · [04 Protocol Reachability](/d/censprobe-04) · [05 Technique Attribution](/d/censprobe-05) · [06 Analytics & Compare](/d/censprobe-06) · [07 Cloudflare & WARP](/d/censprobe-07) · [08 QUIC & ECH](/d/censprobe-08) · [09 DNS](/d/censprobe-09) · [10 TLS](/d/censprobe-10) · [11 Matrix Heatmap](/d/censprobe-11-matrix-heatmap)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ${group_by:raw} AS group_name, AVG(test_runs.overall_score) AS overall, AVG(test_runs.entry_score) AS entry, AVG(test_runs.exit_score) AS exit, AVG(test_runs.relay_score) AS relay FROM test_runs 
WHERE 
    (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'org' IN (${var_company:singlequote}))
    AND ('AS' || (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'asn') IN (${var_asn:singlequote}))
    AND (COALESCE(test_runs.server_meta->'datacenter'->>'name', 'No DC') IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}))
    AND (test_runs.server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' IN (${var_country:singlequote}))
    AND (test_runs.test_id IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}))
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY overall DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT test_runs.test_id) AS matched FROM test_runs 
WHERE 
    (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'org' IN (${var_company:singlequote}))
    AND ('AS' || (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'asn') IN (${var_asn:singlequote}))
    AND (COALESCE(test_runs.server_meta->'datacenter'->>'name', 'No DC') IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}))
    AND (test_runs.server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' IN (${var_country:singlequote}))
    AND (test_runs.test_id IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}))

SELECT test_runs.created_at AS "time", ${group_by:raw} AS metric, AVG(test_runs.overall_score) AS value FROM test_runs 
WHERE 
    (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'org' IN (${var_company:singlequote}))
    AND ('AS' || (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'asn') IN (${var_asn:singlequote}))
    AND (COALESCE(test_runs.server_meta->'datacenter'->>'name', 'No DC') IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}))
    AND (test_runs.server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' IN (${var_country:singlequote}))
    AND (test_runs.test_id IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}))
 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ${group_by:raw} AS group_name, tr.method, COUNT(*) AS detections FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs ON test_runs.id = tr.test_run_id 
WHERE 
    (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'org' IN (${var_company:singlequote}))
    AND ('AS' || (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'asn') IN (${var_asn:singlequote}))
    AND (COALESCE(test_runs.server_meta->'datacenter'->>'name', 'No DC') IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}))
    AND (test_runs.server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' IN (${var_country:singlequote}))
    AND (test_runs.test_id IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}))
 AND tr.method IS NOT NULL AND tr.verdict = 'BLOCKED' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

SELECT test_runs.test_id, 'AS' || (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'asn') AS asn, test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'org' AS org, COALESCE(test_runs.server_meta->'datacenter'->>'name', 'No DC') AS datacenter, test_runs.server_meta->'location'->>'city' AS city, test_runs.server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' AS country, test_runs.overall_score FROM test_runs 
WHERE 
    (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'org' IN (${var_company:singlequote}))
    AND ('AS' || (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'asn') IN (${var_asn:singlequote}))
    AND (COALESCE(test_runs.server_meta->'datacenter'->>'name', 'No DC') IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}))
    AND (test_runs.server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' IN (${var_country:singlequote}))
    AND (test_runs.test_id IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}))
 ORDER BY test_runs.overall_score ASC

panels.title: Company × ${var_protocol} reachability (worst-first)
panels.description: % sessions with verdict=OK for the selected protocol, grouped by company. Worst-first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'org', '— unknown —') AS company,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN pr.verdict='OK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
        NULLIF(COUNT(pr.id), 0), 1) AS "% OK",
  COUNT(pr.id) AS sessions
FROM test_runs
JOIN listener_sessions ls ON ls.test_run_id = test_runs.id
JOIN protocol_results pr ON pr.session_id = ls.id
WHERE pr.protocol = ${var_protocol:singlequote}
    AND (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'org' IN (${var_company:singlequote}))
    AND ('AS' || (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'asn') IN (${var_asn:singlequote}))
    AND (COALESCE(test_runs.server_meta->'datacenter'->>'name', 'No DC') IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}))
    AND (test_runs.server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' IN (${var_country:singlequote}))
    AND (test_runs.test_id IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}))
    AND (('Mobile' IN (${var_client_network:singlequote}) AND ls.is_mobile)
         OR ('Whitelist' IN (${var_client_network:singlequote}) AND ls.is_whitelist)
         OR ('Regular' IN (${var_client_network:singlequote}) AND NOT ls.is_mobile AND NOT ls.is_whitelist))
GROUP BY company
ORDER BY "% OK" ASC NULLS FIRST
